_comment: 人工补充的英文释义：WordNet 查不到的词（多为短语、功能词）。格式 word -> { def, example }。build-pet-bank.js 会优先使用这里的释义。

high heels.def: women's shoes with tall narrow heels
high heels.example: She wore black high heels to the party.

social media.def: websites and apps where people share information and ideas
social media.example: Teenagers spend hours a day on social media.

primary school.def: a school for children between about five and eleven years old
primary school.example: My sister is still at primary school.

secondary school.def: a school for children between about eleven and eighteen years old
secondary school.example: He started at a new secondary school last September.

head teacher.def: the teacher who is in charge of a school
head teacher.example: The head teacher spoke to all the parents.

ice cream.def: a sweet frozen food made from milk and sugar
ice cream.example: We had ice cream on the beach.

living room.def: the room in a house where people sit together and relax
living room.example: The family watched TV in the living room.

dining room.def: a room in which meals are eaten
dining room.example: Dinner is ready in the dining room.

mother tongue.def: the first language that you learn as a child

police station.def: the local office of the police
police station.example: He reported the theft at the police station.

fire station.def: a building where fire engines are kept
fire station.example: The fire station is next to the park.

shopping centre.def: a large building with many shops inside
shopping centre.example: They spent the afternoon at the shopping centre.

traffic lights.def: a set of red and green lights that control traffic
traffic lights.example: Turn left at the traffic lights.

bus stop.def: a place where a bus regularly stops to pick up passengers
bus stop.example: I waited for twenty minutes at the bus stop.

petrol station.def: a place where you can buy fuel for a car
petrol station.example: We stopped at a petrol station to fill up.

check in.def: to register when you arrive at a hotel or an airport
check in.example: Please check in two hours before your flight.

check out.def: to pay your bill and leave a hotel
check out.example: We have to check out before eleven.

post office.def: a place where you can buy stamps and send letters or parcels
post office.example: I posted the letter at the post office.

bank account.def: an arrangement with a bank in which it keeps your money
bank account.example: She opened a bank account when she started work.

credit card.def: a small plastic card used to buy things and pay later
credit card.example: Can I pay by credit card?

debit card.def: a plastic card that takes money directly from your bank account
debit card.example: He paid for the shopping with his debit card.

try on.def: to put on a piece of clothing to see if it fits
try on.example: Can I try on these trousers, please?

break the record.def: to do something faster or better than anyone before
break the record.example: She broke the world record for the 100 metres.

give up.def: to stop doing something, especially because it is difficult
give up.example: Never give up learning a language.

keep up.def: to move at the same speed as someone or something
keep up.example: I could not keep up with the rest of the group.

wild animal.def: an animal that lives in nature and is not kept by people
wild animal.example: Lions are wild animals, not pets.

on time.def: at the correct or arranged time, not late
on time.example: The train arrived exactly on time.

in time.def: early enough, before it is too late
in time.example: We got to the cinema just in time.

during.def: through the whole of a period of time, or at some point in it
during.example: Please do not talk during the film.

until.def: up to the time that something happens
until.example: We waited until the rain stopped.

since.def: from a time in the past until now

as soon as.example: Call me as soon as you arrive.

by the time.def: before or when a particular moment arrives
by the time.example: By the time we arrived, the match had ended.

safety belt.def: a strap in a car that keeps you in your seat

speed limit.def: the fastest speed that is allowed on a road
speed limit.example: The speed limit here is 50 kilometres an hour.

traffic jam.def: a long line of cars that cannot move
traffic jam.example: We were stuck in a traffic jam for an hour.

turn left.def: to change direction and go towards the left

turn right.def: to change direction and go towards the right

go straight on.def: to continue in the same direction
go straight on.example: Go straight on for about 200 metres.

next to.def: beside; very close to someone or something
next to.example: The bank is next to the supermarket.

among.def: in the middle of a group of people or things
among.example: She was among the first to arrive.

satnav.def: a device in a car that shows you the way to a place
satnav.example: The satnav told us to take the next exit.

electric car.def: a car that is powered by electricity instead of petrol
electric car.example: Electric cars are quiet and clean.

résumé.def: a short written account of your education and experience
résumé.example: Send your résumé with your application.

office worker.def: a person who works in an office
office worker.example: Most office workers start at nine o'clock.

sales assistant.def: a person whose job is to sell things in a shop
sales assistant.example: The sales assistant helped me find a jacket.

raise money.def: to collect money for a particular purpose, often by asking people
raise money.example: The students raised money for a local charity.

a.m.def: between midnight and midday; in the morning

according to.def: as stated by someone or something
according to.example: According to the weather forecast, it will rain.

against.def: in opposition to; touching or hitting something
against.example: She played against her best friend.

although.def: despite the fact that; even though
although.example: Although it was late, we kept walking.

and.def: used to join two words, phrases or clauses

answerphone.def: a machine that records telephone messages
answerphone.example: Nobody answered, so I left a message on the answerphone.

anything.def: any thing at all, no matter what
anything.example: Is there anything else you need?

apart from.example: Apart from the rain, the trip was great.

app.def: a program you download and use on a phone
app.example: This app helps you learn new words.

at first.def: in the beginning, before anything else happens
at first.example: At first I did not like the film.

at the same time.def: during the same moment or period
at the same time.example: They both spoke at the same time.

base on.def: to use something as the starting point or source
base on.example: The film is based on a true story.

be over.def: to have finished or come to an end
be over.example: The match will be over at five.

because.example: I stayed at home because I was ill.

because of.def: as a result of; due to
because of.example: The game was cancelled because of the rain.

beside.def: next to; at the side of someone or something

booking office.def: a place where you can buy tickets
booking office.example: Tickets are sold at the booking office.

by accident.example: I broke the glass by accident.

by mistake.example: I took your umbrella by mistake.

cashpoint.def: a machine outside a bank that gives you money
cashpoint.example: I need to get some cash at the cashpoint.

could.def: was able to; used for polite requests or possibilities
could.example: Could you help me with this bag?

dr.def: a short way of writing Doctor before a name
dr.example: Dr King is our new teacher.

due to.example: The delay was due to bad weather.

dvd player.example: We watched the film on the DVD player.

else.def: other than what is mentioned; different

even though.example: Even though he was tired, he finished the work.

everybody.def: all the people in a group

everyone.def: all the people in a group

everything.def: all things in a group or situation
everything.example: Everything in the shop is half price.

extreme sport.def: a sport that is very dangerous and exciting

for.def: intended to be given to or used by someone

from.def: starting at a particular place or time

get fit.def: to become healthy and strong through exercise
get fit.example: I go running to get fit.

good evening.def: a polite greeting used in the evening
good evening.example: Good evening, everyone. Please sit down.

hairdryer.def: a machine that blows hot air to dry your hair
hairdryer.example: The hotel room has a hairdryer.

hand in.def: to give something to a person in charge
hand in.example: Hand in your homework by Friday.

have to.def: must; used to say something is necessary
have to.example: I have to get up early tomorrow.

headteacher.def: the teacher in charge of a school
headteacher.example: The headteacher talked to the students.

herself.def: used when a woman or girl does something to her own person

hey.def: a word used to greet someone or get attention

him.def: used as the object form of he

himself.def: used when a man or boy does something to his own person
himself.example: He looked at himself in the mirror.

hoodie.example: He wore a black hoodie and jeans.

horse-riding.def: the activity of riding a horse

how.def: in what way; to what degree

how much.def: used to ask about the price or the amount of something
how much.example: How much does this shirt cost?

id card.def: a card that shows who you are
id card.example: You need an ID card to take the exam.

if.def: used to talk about a condition or a possibility
if.example: If it rains, we will stay at home.

in front of.def: in a position before or facing something
in front of.example: The bus stopped in front of the school.

in half.example: Please cut the cake in half.

in ink.def: written with a pen and ink
in ink.example: Fill in the form in ink, not pencil.

in order to.def: for the purpose of; so that you can
in order to.example: She got up early in order to catch the train.

into.def: moving to a position inside something

itself.def: used to show that a thing does something to its own self

look forward to.def: to feel happy and excited about something that will happen
look forward to.example: I look forward to seeing you again.

made of.def: produced or built from a particular material
made of.example: The table is made of wood.

motor-racing.def: the sport of racing fast cars or motorbikes

myself.def: used when you do something to your own person
myself.example: I hurt myself in the kitchen.

no one.example: No one was at home when I called.

noticeboard.def: a board on a wall where notices are put
noticeboard.example: The exam timetable is on the noticeboard.

of.def: belonging to or connected with something
of.example: She is a friend of mine.

oh dear.def: a phrase used to show sadness or sympathy
oh dear.example: Oh dear, I forgot my keys.

on business.def: because of your work; for a work purpose
on business.example: My father is in Berlin on business.

on foot.def: walking, not travelling by car or bus
on foot.example: We went to the market on foot.

on holiday.def: away from home or work, having a rest
on holiday.example: They are on holiday in Italy.

on sale.def: offered for sale, often at a lower price
on sale.example: These shoes are on sale this week.

on vacation.def: away from work or school, having a holiday
on vacation.example: She is on vacation in Spain.

onto.def: moving to a position on the surface of something
onto.example: The cat jumped onto the table.

opening hours.def: the times when a shop or business is open
opening hours.example: The library's opening hours are 9 to 6.

ought.def: should; used to say what is right or necessary
ought.example: You ought to see a doctor.

ours.def: the one or ones belonging to us

ourselves.def: used when we do something to our own persons
ourselves.example: We enjoyed ourselves at the beach.

out of order.example: The lift is out of order today.

p.m.def: between midday and midnight; in the afternoon or evening

pence.def: a small unit of British money, plural of penny

penfriend.def: someone you write to but may never meet
penfriend.example: She has a penfriend in Canada.

ring back.example: I'll ring you back in ten minutes.

selfie.def: a photo you take of yourself
selfie.example: We took a selfie in front of the castle.

shall.def: used with I and we to talk about the future or make offers
shall.example: Shall we go for a walk?

she.def: the female person or animal already mentioned

should.def: used to say what is right, advisable or expected

smartphone.def: a mobile phone that can run apps and use the internet
smartphone.example: He checks his email on his smartphone.

something.def: a thing that is not named or known
something.example: I have something to tell you.

sports centre.def: a building with places for doing different sports
sports centre.example: The new sports centre has a pool and a gym.

stay behind.def: to remain in a place after other people leave
stay behind.example: She stayed behind to help the teacher.

superhero.def: a fictional character with special powers

take care of.def: to look after someone or something
take care of.example: Can you take care of my cat this weekend?

text message.def: a short written message sent by mobile phone
text message.example: I sent her a text message this morning.

than.def: used to compare two things or people
than.example: This film is better than the last one.

the.def: used before a noun that is already known or has been mentioned

them.def: used as the object form of they
them.example: I saw them at the station.

themselves.def: used when people do something to their own persons
themselves.example: They taught themselves to play the guitar.

these.def: the plural of this; the things near you

this.def: the thing or person near you that is being talked about

those.def: the plural of that; the things further away
those.example: Those shoes are too big for me.

to.def: in the direction of; used before the basic form of a verb
to.example: I want to learn to swim.

turn into.def: to become something different; to change into
turn into.example: The caterpillar turns into a butterfly.

unless.example: We will play tennis unless it rains.

upon.def: on; a more formal word for on
upon.example: The story is based upon a real event.

via.def: by way of; through a particular place or method
via.example: We flew to Rome via Paris.

video clip.example: Watch the video clip and answer the questions.

we.def: the speaker together with other people
we.example: We live in a small town.

wetsuit.def: a tight suit worn for swimming or diving in cold water
wetsuit.example: He put on his wetsuit before surfing.

what.def: used to ask about a thing or an action

when.def: at what time; at the time that

whenever.def: every time that; at any time that
whenever.example: Come and see me whenever you like.

whether.def: used to talk about a choice between two possibilities
whether.example: I don't know whether to go or stay.

which.def: used to ask or talk about one or more things from a group

whose.def: belonging to whom; used to ask about the owner

without.def: not having or not using something

would.def: used for polite requests or imagined situations
would.example: Would you like a cup of tea?

you.def: the person or people being spoken to

you know.def: a phrase used in speech when you are thinking what to say
you know.example: It was, you know, a bit strange.

your.def: belonging to the person or people spoken to

yours.def: the one or ones belonging to you
yours.example: That bag over there is yours.

yourself.def: used when you do something to your own person
yourself.example: Be careful not to hurt yourself.

as long as.example: You can go out as long as you are home by nine.

her.def: used as the object form of she; belonging to her

its.def: belonging to a thing or an animal

by name.def: using the name of someone or something

including.def: having something as part of a group

freezing.def: extremely cold; at or below the temperature of ice

cheers.def: said when drinking together, or as a way of saying thank you

prizes.def: things given to the winner of a competition

studies.def: the work of learning at school or university

facilities.def: buildings, rooms or equipment for a particular purpose

headphones.def: a pair of small speakers worn over the ears

boots.def: strong shoes that cover the foot and the lower leg

gloves.def: coverings for the hands with separate parts for each finger

sweets.def: small pieces of sweet food made with sugar

tins.def: metal containers used for keeping food

recycled.def: treated so that it can be used again

well done.def: used to praise someone for doing something well

windsurfing.def: the sport of riding on water on a board with a sail

second-hand.def: used by someone else before; not new
